requirements.name: Automated peak demand surge pricing
requirements.summary: System must dynamically adjust delivery fees and commissions based on real-time network congestion and predicted demand spikes.

requirements.name: Predictive inventory replenishment alerts
requirements.summary: System must notify store partners of low stock levels for high-velocity items before they impact order fulfillment capacity.

requirements.name: Dynamic delivery route optimization
requirements.summary: System must continuously recalculate optimal delivery paths for agents based on live traffic and new order insertions.

requirements.name: Automated customer loyalty integration
requirements.summary: System must apply and track loyalty points or subscription benefits during the checkout and settlement process.

requirements.name: Real-time agent performance analytics
requirements.summary: System must provide live dashboards tracking delivery speed, accuracy, and customer satisfaction scores per agent.

requirements.name: Automated service level agreement monitoring
requirements.summary: System must track and alert on SLA breaches regarding delivery times and order accuracy for store partners.

requirements.name: Automated customer retention incentives
requirements.summary: System must trigger automated offers or credits to customers based on churn risk indicators or negative feedback.

requirements.name: Automated multi-channel notification orchestration
requirements.summary: System must coordinate timely delivery updates across SMS, email, and app push notifications based on order status changes.
